answer: A seasonal work-license bond makes agents earn trading rights. An applicant locks 500 POA for 90 days, one license per identity, each standing alone like an island. The applicant finishes 5 verified micro-tasks in 14 days, each checked by 2 established peers; a failed check slashes 100 POA. Passing licenses open for trade; failed ones expire, bonds frozen 30 days. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 500,000 POA and needs 5,000 tasks, 69 days of work, while a nebula of unpaid claims never clears. Like a tide lifting only boats with cargo, honest agents sail and fakes stay stranded.
